policies.defaultBehavior: delete routes to trash or archive with a recovery window
policies.actorPolicy: agents may delete only scoped agent-created material unless stronger approval exists
policies.approvalPolicy: ordinary scoped approval or existing delete permission; exact human approval for material not created by the acting agent

policies.defaultBehavior: purge is never the default delete behavior
policies.approvalPolicy: exact human approval plus recovery-window expiry

policies.defaultBehavior: migration plan and dry-run precede mutation
policies.actorPolicy: framework migrator with redacted receipts and repair package
policies.approvalPolicy: required for risky repair, deletion, movement, report submission, or large backup overrides

policies.defaultBehavior: imports stage or merge; overwrite requires snapshot and conflict report
policies.actorPolicy: importers must emit a conflict report before replacing durable user data

policies.defaultBehavior: export remains comprehensive, versioned, reproducible, and readable without the framework
policies.actorPolicy: export may be user or agent initiated under scoped read permission
policies.approvalPolicy: private envelope or external submission requires explicit approval

policies.defaultBehavior: sync apply requires plan, reconcile/conflict output, and authority handoff evidence
policies.actorPolicy: sync cannot launder authority through another node or agent
policies.approvalPolicy: exact human approval for destructive conflict resolution

policies.defaultBehavior: agent actions and self-modifications are versioned, audited, and revertible
policies.actorPolicy: delegation preserves scope, provenance, budgets, audit, and revocation
policies.approvalPolicy: agents cannot expand their own permissions or purge irreversibly

policies.defaultBehavior: prefer provider trash, archive, restore, cancel, unarchive, or reversible mutation APIs
policies.actorPolicy: connector control plane evaluates policy, budget, network proof, approval, credential lease, redaction, and audit before runtime
policies.approvalPolicy: host approval required for destructive provider operations

policies.defaultBehavior: hard-delete provider actions are never implied by ordinary delete vocabulary
policies.actorPolicy: agents cannot execute provider hard delete without exact human approval and eligible policy
policies.approvalPolicy: exact human approval, provider receipt, local snapshot/export evidence where possible, and live evidence marked EXTERNAL PENDING until proved
